target_type_scope.B_x: BoundaryInteraction_x : provisional target parameter; role label only, governed identity not established.
target_type_scope.D_rel: RelationalDomain_x : provisional target parameter; role label only, governed identity not established.
target_type_scope.R: Residue_x : provisional target parameter; role label only, governed identity not established.

target_role_guard: Boundary, relational-domain, and residue are hypothesis roles; their labels do not establish target identity, type, or authority.
undefined_guard: UNDEFINED is not coerced to NO_ASPECT or MISMATCH.

hypotheses.relation_bearing_surface: A boundary-interaction aspect extracted from Y under the declared context scope.
hypotheses.positive_condition: Extractor returns EXTRACTED(b_y) and a typed relation relates b_y to B_x.
hypotheses.local_rejection_condition: Complete extractor returns NO_ASPECT OR an extracted aspect exists and the governed boundary relation definitively rejects B_x.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Extractor, applicability, target typing, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.global_guard: Rejecting boundary mediation does not establish target-level non-relation for D_rel or R.

hypotheses.relation_bearing_surface: A relational-domain aspect extracted from Y that constrains applicability without identifying Y with D_rel.
hypotheses.positive_condition: Extractor returns EXTRACTED(d_y) and a typed relation establishes applicability to D_rel.
hypotheses.local_rejection_condition: Complete extractor returns NO_ASPECT OR an extracted aspect exists and the governed domain relation definitively rejects D_rel.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Extractor, applicability, target typing, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.global_guard: Rejecting domain mediation does not establish target-level non-relation for B_x or R.

hypotheses.relation_bearing_surface: A residue-relevant aspect or history reference carried by Y without identifying Y with R.
hypotheses.positive_condition: Extractor returns EXTRACTED(r_y) and a typed residue relation establishes the relevant linkage.
hypotheses.local_rejection_condition: Complete extractor returns NO_ASPECT OR an extracted aspect exists and the governed residue relation definitively rejects R.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Extractor, applicability, target typing, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.global_guard: Rejecting residue mediation does not establish target-level non-relation for B_x or D_rel.

hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable; complete rule-set evidence is required.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Complete applicable boundary rules establish no authorized relation for B_x.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Boundary rule-set completeness, authority, provenance, applicability, or dependency evidence is incomplete.
hypotheses.falsification_case: An authorized applicable boundary relation is found.

hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable; complete rule-set evidence is required.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Complete applicable domain rules establish no authorized relation for D_rel.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Domain rule-set completeness, authority, provenance, applicability, or dependency evidence is incomplete.
hypotheses.falsification_case: An authorized applicable domain relation is found.

hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable; complete rule-set evidence is required.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Complete applicable residue rules establish no authorized relation for R.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Residue rule-set completeness, authority, provenance, applicability, or dependency evidence is incomplete.
hypotheses.falsification_case: An authorized applicable residue relation is found.

hypotheses.definition_candidate: ContextRelation_x(Y,target)=UNDEFINED when required type, aspect, rule, authority, provenance, applicability, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable while required evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Not applicable; undefined context is not coerced to mismatch.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Any required context evidence is missing or unresolved.
hypotheses.resolution_case: Complete governed evidence resolves each selected target relation to relates or does-not-relate.

global_non_relation_candidate: GlobalNoContextRelation_x(Y) := NoContextRelation_x(Y,B_x) AND NoContextRelation_x(Y,D_rel) AND NoContextRelation_x(Y,R)
global_guard: A relation found for one target falsifies only that target's non-relation and the global conjunction; it does not decide the other targets.
threshold_independence: All context hypotheses are formed without source or observation distinction-floor outcomes.
